package.description: 智能 AI 办公工具

en-US.longDescription: OfficeAI Assistant is a free intelligent AI office tool for Microsoft Office and WPS. Whether you want to know “how to enter a check mark”, “how to add text before inserting a table”, or “which formula to use”, AI Office Assistant can always provide you with fast and accurate solutions. Through simple instructions, ExcelAI plugins can help you automatically complete complex formula calculations and choose functions. WordAI plugin can also help you organize weekly reports, write meeting key points, summarize content, and improve writing. All in all, OfficeAI Assistant will greatly improve your working efficiency and make your daily work easier and more convenient.

zh-CN.description: 智能 AI 办公工具
zh-CN.longDescription: OfficeAI 助手是一款免费的智能 AI 办公工具软件，专为 Microsoft Office 和 WPS 用户打造。无论你是在寻找如何输入“打勾（√）符号”的方法，还是想知道“怎么在插入表格前添加文字”，或者“该用哪个公式”，AI 办公助手都能为你提供快速、准确的解决方案。通过简单的指令，ExcelAI 插件可以帮你自动完成复杂的公式计算、函数选择。WordAI 插件还具备整理周报、撰写会议纪要、总结内容、以及文案润色的强大功能。总之，OfficeAI 助手将大大提升你的办公效率，让日常工作变得更加轻松便捷。
